description: This file defines the TokenRefreshAuthenticator class which implements the OkHttp Authenticator interface to handle automatic token refresh upon receiving HTTP 401 responses. It manages token refresh logic, prevents infinite retry loops, and avoids attempts on authentication endpoints.

classes.name: TokenRefreshAuthenticator
classes.description: An OkHttp Authenticator that attempts to refresh authentication tokens when receiving a 401 response, ensuring token validity and avoiding infinite retry loops.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Handles the authentication process by attempting to refresh tokens if conditions are met, avoiding infinite retries and non-auth endpoints.

methods.name: responseCount
methods.description: Counts the number of responses in the chain to prevent multiple retries for the same request.
